name: macro-api
description: REST API owning food entries, daily goals and coach-access grants. Serves a Client's own log/goal (own-rows reach) and a Coach's read-only view of the Clients who granted them access (via a relation reach). Persists to macro-db. Does not send email or any notification, and does not look up nutrition facts from any external food database — all macro values are entered by the Client.
